title: Unbrewed Telemetry Game Replay v1
description: The full replay bundle of one finished live game, keyed by the engine's live game id. Mirrors ReplayBundle in unbrewed-engine/protocol/protocol.ts; the engine is the authority on the interior of config, actionLog and meta.

schemaVersion.description: Optional. The version of record is the request path (/v1/replays); producers may stamp it anyway so a stored payload is self-describing.

gameId.description: The engine's live game id — the same id the /v1/games submission for this game carries.

config.description: Engine-owned wire shape (InitConfig + map). Deliberately not enumerated: the engine's preValidateReplayBundle is the authority on its interior.
